messages.subject: changing garphical parameters of effectplot
parts:
Dear all,
I'd like to modify the effectplot settings, i.e. line style, colors of
lines and plotting symbols.
I did not succed with modifying par() or within the effectplot()-
function. Could someone help me out?
Best wishes
Christof

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] changing garphical parameters of effectplot
parts:
Currently there's no ability to do this. But you can save the function
to a file (use dput() or copy the function from the R/qtl source; it's
in qtl/R/effectplot.R), edit it to suit your purposes, and source into
R.

karl
